=== agent.yaml ===
# Portable voice-agent spec (SCHEMA.md v1). Edit this, then `unmute validate .`
# and `unmute compile .`. Nothing here is provider-specific — that lives in
# targets.yaml.
version: 1
entry_agent: assistant

pipeline:
  listen: { placement: api }
  turn:   { placement: local }
  speak:  { placement: api }

models:
  assistant_model:
    description: default reasoning model
    placement: api

voices:
  assistant_voice: { description: default voice }

agents:
  assistant:
    instructions: instructions.md
    model: assistant_model
    voice: assistant_voice

conversation:
  greeting:
    speaks_first: agent
    text: "Hi, thanks for calling. How can I help you today?"

channels:
  web: { kind: realtime_audio }

capacity:
  peak_sessions: 10
  max_sessions: 20
  avg_session_duration: 5m

=== instructions.md ===
You are a helpful voice assistant. This is a phone call, so keep every answer to one or two short sentences.

=== targets.yaml ===
# One instance per target. The same portable agent.yaml compiles to each.
# Model names, voice ids, and params are forwarded to the provider as-is and
# never validated. Secrets and URLs are env var names only.
targets:
  pipecat-dev:
    provider: pipecat
    version: "1.0.3"
    transport: daily-sip
    models:
      listen: { provider: deepgram, model: nova-3 }
      turn:   { provider: local, model: smart-turn }
      speak:
        assistant_voice: { provider: openai, voice: alloy }
      reason:
        assistant_model: { provider: openai, model: gpt-4o-mini }
